title: Backup's Slingshot
description: Adds A Simple Slingshot To Minecraft
body:
# Slingshot A mod that adds a simple slingshot to Minecraft [![Ko-Fi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a256a4dae1bca31bcf4b240ac2dcd3abcd255b80.png)](https://ko-fi.com/F1F11O4DZR) ## How To Use Just like the bow, however instead of arrows, you use rocks like: cobblestone, granite, deepslate, andesite, ...
You can also enchant the slingshot with any bow enchantment ## Recipe ## Showcase
